learner_operation: Read the integrand, simplify a product or quotient when necessary, identify each term's coefficient and exponent, integrate each term (raise the exponent by one and divide by that new exponent), preserve signs and combine. Radio learners must distinguish the resulting primitive from near-miss primitives; a blank preceding +C requests only its nonconstant part.

fixed_features.feature: Two nonzero power terms, indefinite integral and one integration constant.
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 703 and e-372 establish linearity plus extraction of constants; source moderate records add one product/quotient rewrite.

limitations: Selection uses explicit synthetic new entity IDs; live allocation, active policy weights, learner history and concurrent inventory changes are unavailable. Conclusions are conditional on a positively weighted moderate band and fresh candidates; the unconfigured first-ID fallback and zero-weight exclusion were also inspected.
No finite audit establishes absence of other shortcuts. Small perfect length-probe subgroups are exploratory observations, not additional asserted defects.
